notes.title: Update notes for build 20061068
notes.notes: [p]Hello N.O.R.M.s [/p][p][/p][p]I'm pretty excited about this latest update.  Barring any hotfixes or balancing tweaks, this will probably be the last content update before launch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][p][i]-New Alarm System-[/i] Smoke from cigarettes/cigars, smoke from killing the clean bot, setting things on fire with laser weapons will trigger the alarm if it contacts any of the sprinklers.  [/p][p]The alarm can also be triggered manually by the fire alarm pulls if you want to increase difficulty.  [/p][p]The alarm will increase the alert significantly when triggered.[/p][p]The alarm will trigger sprinklers which will flash red light and extinguish any fire under them. There is one alarm system per section [/p][p]-Cigarettes and Cigars are now consumable.When activated they will increase your healing rate and slightly restore your health until they are consumed. They will decrease your stamina and the smoke can set off the alarm if you smoke under a fire alarm.[/p][p]-Vending Machines now drop cigarettes and cigars[/p][p]-Partial fix for bug for items falling through floor…[/p][p]-Added a backpack that is unlocked at the start of the game[/p][p]-Added a medical backpack that can be found in medical crates[/p][p]-Added an undershirt [/p][p]-Added a bucket helmet[/p][p]-Rebalanced  gear/loot drops/room spawns to drop weapons and gear sooner and more often[/p][p]-Increased value of Pristine Flesh[/p][p]-Updated enemy behavior, added some attack sounds. Enemies with guns will now engage more reliably after making an alert noise. [/p][p][b]UI Updates[/b] [/p][p]-Enlarged gameplay UI[/p][p]-Added UI elements that let you know when you have equipped an item that can be toggled on/off.  Right now it displays the default controls for F, N, V and L for flashlights, night vision, item toggle and weapon laser.[/p][p]-Added tracking for Run and Game stats[/p][p]-Unified the Player Stats and Objectives into one UI panel that can be toggled on/off [/p][p]-Added an Auto Deposit button to the Terminal store that moves all Flesh and Silicon from your inventory to scrap[/p][p]-Labeled Snap points on player with correct names[/p][p]-Colorized the gameplay log[/p][p]-Cleaned up gear/item popup information[/p][p]-Update the main menu[/p][p]-Refined equip/unequip cycle.[/p][p]-Removed some of the larger objects from the foreground[/p][p]-Ammo count update fixed[/p][p]-Marsupial implant persistence fixed[/p][p]-Fixed Cleaning Robot behavior[/p][p]-Added equip/unequip sounds for all gear, weapons, attachments and implants [/p][p]-Cleaned up timing for environmental music triggers[/p][p]-Discord button on main menu fixed[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577413/20615ff3c447bbe350e243f7780c693b65419bb2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Developer's Note
notes.notes:
[p]Firstly, I want to just thank everyone who Wishlisted No Time For Pants and took the time to play the demo in June's Steam Next Fest.  Better late than never, but if you do come across this, Thank you. [/p][p][/p][p]While I have not been adding updates to the Steam store page, I have been very busy finishing the full version of NTFP.  I still have a few loose ends to tie up before release, but I am really happy with the way things have turned out. A lot has changed since the demo, and I want to take a minute and lay out some of the changes and a general update. [/p][p][/p][p]I've started a Discord server.  This is where I want to engage with help, tips, suggestions, bug reporting etc.
[url="https://discord.com/channels/1410216080697331735/1410216081506697309"]https://discord.com/channels/1410216080697331735/1410216081506697309[/url][/p][p]I've added a button to the main menu so players can check in easily after release, which I have set to Oct. 24, 2025.

Moving forward updates should be included with new builds on a regular basis.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Gameplay[/u][/b][/p][p][b]Implants[/b] - Implants are persistent character improvements. They can improve your search speed, reload speed, max health, max weight etc.  They use power.  When you are out of batteries they draw from your health.[/p][p][b]Power Weapons, Armor and Attachments[/b] - weapons that use battery power, power equipment and armor that auto generate power and store it.[/p][p][b]Heat management[/b] - Power weapons produce heat.  You can augment power weapons and equipment with attachments to help you manage your heat.  Too much heat will cause you to catch fire.[/p][p][b]Objectives[/b] - Progress to unlock other floors has been rebalanced.[/p][p][b]Cover system[/b] - aiming behind certain objects in the game will give you cover.  As of now all incoming fire is blocked.  You can shoot from cover.[/p][p][b]Base Stats - [/b]The base search speed has been made slightly quicker[/p][p][b]Game Start - [/b]Added headlamp to the start[b] [/b][/p][p][b]More weapons[/b][/p][p][b]More gear[/b][/p][p][b]More attachments[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Gameworld[/u][/b][/p][p]The Lobby level has been redone[/p][p]N.O.R.M. Bay floor was added[/p][p]Laboratory section was added[/p][p]More sub rooms have been added[/p][p]Added 2 Boss fights[/p][p]Loot tables have been rebalanced[/p][p]Added Security keys that will unlock Security rooms throughout the sections[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]UI[/u][/b][/p][p]In-game UI has been overhauled[/p][p]In-game activity log has been moved to the side, lasts longer, shows more than one item at a time[/p][p]Favorite Button has been added to store items to improve gear/loadout selection at Terminal[/p][p]Options menu added to Main menu[/p][p]Added music that plays intermittently in different sections during gameplay[/p][p]Added audio control to options menu[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]


[/p]
